episodes.title: A Businessman
episodes.summary: An aeroplane headed to Fukuoka is hijacked midair. Ki-tae attempts to negotiate with the terrorists but, in the process, reveals his true identity.

episodes.title: The Power of the Dog
episodes.summary: Geon-young has been working to bring down the Manjae Gang - unaware they're being protected by the KCIA. In response, Ki-tae is ordered to investigate.

episodes.title: The Age of Prohibition
episodes.summary: Kitae gets involved in an illegal operation as Geonyoung closes in on the truth.

episodes.title: In the Name of the Father
episodes.summary: Kitae meets with Ikeda clan to scale up operations while Geonyoung follows him to Japan.

episodes.title: War of Blood
episodes.summary: Geonyoung figures out how to arrest Kitae, who obliviously continues to expand his business.

episodes.title: Made in Korea
episodes.summary: Kitae searches for a new business partner with Yuji, while Geonyoung sets a trap to catch him.

episodes.title: Kumicho (The Number One)
episodes.summary: In 1979, Kitae is enjoying his power as deputy director of the KCIA when an unexpected event occurs.

episodes.title: Survival of the Fittest
episodes.summary: Kitae has an unexpected encounter with Kihyun, and Yejin, now a prosecutor, joins the investigation.

episodes.title: Enemy's Enemy
episodes.summary: Geonyoung returns and begins closing in, putting Kitae in a desperate position.

episodes.title: The Beginning of the End
episodes.summary: Kitae sets a dangerous plan in motion as part of his relentless pursuit of power.

episodes.title: God's Will
episodes.summary: As Geonyoung closes in, the conflict between Kitae and Kihyun continues to escalate.

episodes.title: Made in Korea
episodes.summary: Kitae and Geonyoung each set their final plans in motion.
